issues.description: The template for the Kakuro exercise uses the parameter name 'ancilla_register' in the state_preparation method signature, while the problem statement and the solution implementation consistently use the identifier 'auxiliary_register'. This inconsistent identifier naming for the same conceptual register can confuse students when mapping the exercise text to the provided template and the reference solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a single consistent identifier across artifacts. Rename the template parameter 'ancilla_register' to 'auxiliary_register' in the state_preparation signature (and any other template occurrences), and update any docstrings/comments to use 'auxiliary_register' to match the problem statement and solution.
